 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Objects on the right are copied into the matching pattern-shaped holes
    # in the framed panels on the left. Infer matching by pattern silhouette.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate full-width separator rows, and the framed panel's side borders.
    sep = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    # Frames use color at upper-left; boundaries are full horizontal lines.
    bg = grid[0][0]
    sep = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == bg for v in grid[r][:5])]
    # Find panel width from its initial contiguous background border.
    pw = next((c for c in range(1,w) if grid[0][c] != bg), 5)
    # Actual panels have full bg separator rows in columns 0..pw-1.
    bounds = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == bg for c in range(pw))]
    out = [row[:pw] for row in grid]
    # Get right-side nonzero objects, grouped by connected color; preserve shape.
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(pw,w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for q in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
            yy,xx=q
            if 0<=yy<h and pw<=xx<w and q not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
              seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
        minr=min(y for y,x in cells); minc=min(x for y,x in cells)
        shape=frozenset((y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells)
        objs.append((shape,col))
    # Panel hole patterns are the zero cells in each region; match exact silhouette.
    for i in range(len(bounds)-1):
      top,bot=bounds[i],bounds[i+1]
      cells=[(r,c) for r in range(top+1,bot) for c in range(1,pw-1) if grid[r][c]==0]
      if not cells: continue
      mr=min(r for r,c in cells); mc=min(c for r,c in cells)
      shape=frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cells)
      match=next((color for sh,color in objs if sh==shape),None)
      if match is not None:
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=match
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Keep the framed panels and fill each panel's zero-shaped stencil with
    # the color of the matching right-side object (matching by silhouette).
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]; pw=5
    out=[row[:pw] for row in grid]
    bounds=[r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c]==bg for c in range(pw))]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(pw,w):
       col=grid[r][c]
       if not col or (r,c) in seen: continue
       st=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c));cells=[]
       while st:
        y,x=st.pop();cells.append((y,x))
        for yy,xx in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
         if 0<=yy<h and pw<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
          seen.add((yy,xx));st.append((yy,xx))
       objs.append((cells,col))
    def shapes(cells):
      ret=set()
      for flip in (1,-1):
       for rot in range(4):
        v=[]
        for y,x in cells:
         x*=flip
         for _ in range(rot): y,x=x,-y
         v.append((y,x))
        a=min(y for y,x in v);b=min(x for y,x in v)
        ret.add(frozenset((y-a,x-b) for y,x in v))
      return ret
    for i in range(len(bounds)-1):
      top,bot=bounds[i],bounds[i+1]
      holes=[(r,c) for r in range(top+1,bot) for c in range(1,pw-1) if grid[r][c]==0]
      if not holes: continue
      s=shapes(holes)
      col=next((co for cells,co in objs if s & shapes(cells)),None)
      if col is not None:
       for r,c in holes: out[r][c]=col
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
